research_question: Does the exact tabled HNC phi-squared Fourier cascade outperform non-phi controls for detecting and localising circular terrain anomalies on blinded synthetic holdouts at a calibrated 5 percent false-positive rate?

synthetic_design.target: generic raised pipe with one annular rim; target scales are sampled independently of phi
synthetic_design.train_tune_holdout: independent calibration and test generators; no test-labelled tuning
synthetic_design.paired_inference: shard-level paired sign-flip tests with familywise adjustment

pass_rule.localisation: no worse than best fixed control

boundary: Synthetic or SRTM results are not physical measurements, independent validation, proof of a subsurface deposit, an excavation recommendation, or evidence of extractable energy.
